scenes: We found ninety-one businesses, | fifty-seven of them working in South or Southeast Asia.
Most work in cold storage for food and medicine, and efficient cooling, | then fans, cool roofs and evaporative coolers.
Being listed is not an endorsement. | Companies describe their own products, so ask before you buy.
Find who makes it, then ask the hard questions.
